## Bonesucker (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
 NE Large aberration  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** all-around vision, darkvision 90 ft.; Perception +19  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 88 (8d8+24)  
 **Fort** +5; **Ref** +5; **Will** +7  
 **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** flanking  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft.  
 **Melee** 4 tentacles +9 (1d4+4 plus grab and liquefy bones)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** constrict (1d4+4 plus liquefy bones)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 13, **Con** 17, **Int** 10, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 13  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +11 (+15 grapple); **CMD** 23  
 **Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Climb +15, Perception +19, Stealth +8, Swim +15; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception  
 **Languages** Aklo  

**Special Abilities**

 **All-Around Vision (Ex)** A bonesucker’s symmetrically placed eyes allow it to look in any direction, bestowing a +4 racial bonus on Perception checks. Bonesuckers cannot be flanked.  

 **Liquefy Bones (Ex)** A bonesucker that has successfully grappled an opponent deals 1d2 points of Strength and 1d2 points of Dexterity damage to an opponent as long as the hold is maintained.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any land and underground  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** standard
